name: smwgraphics-redrawn-styled-spiny-fish-porcu-puffer-boss
title: Redrawn Styled Spiny Fish & Porcu-Puffer Boss
description:
A redrawn styled version of the Spiny Fish from Yoshi's Story, and the Porcu Puffer Boss from Mario Pinball Land, they replace Cheep Cheeps.

You may need to remap the Cheep Cheep palettes if you pick the variants that use palette rows E or F.
